top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu, single laureate) is the only proposal that names a writer, and on the common criteria it has the most securely demonstrable case among the shortlisted candidates: an unmistakable voice, formal ambition sustained at very large scale, and imaginative depth that builds memory, the body and dream into one project. From public knowledge, Blinding (Orbitor trilogy) and Solenoid anchor it. The citation is best kept to the prose, which the committee has weighed, and should not claim the poetry or early work. Attribution is clean (one author, one principal language). This judgment rests on public knowledge and translated reception, not on a full reading or independent verification. Open uncertainties remain: Romanian syntax and rhythm cannot be verified directly, and it is unsettled whether Solenoid and the later novels transform the project or only elaborate it. The six-of-six support is not treated as merit. P000 (no award) is ranked second because those reservations do not outweigh the literary case.
